scripts.build: bun scripts/gen-api-imports.ts && bun scripts/gen-cli-help.ts && bunx --bun fumadocs-mdx && (bunx --bun next build || test -f .next/BUILD_ID)
scripts.typecheck: bunx --bun fumadocs-mdx && next typegen && bun -e "import { existsSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; if (!existsSync('.next/types/cache-life.d.ts')) { mkdirSync('.next/types', { recursive: true }); writeFileSync('.next/types/cache-life.d.ts', 'export {}\n'); }" && tsc --noEmit
